playerAbilities.label: Shutdown
playerAbilities.description: Shutdown defenders have the talent to erase receivers from the game. When they enter the zone, their coverage is tighter and interceptions are more frequent on contested catches.

playerAbilities.label: Outside Shade
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly increased chance to react much faster to receiver cut moves when in man coverage and outside the numbers

playerAbilities.label: Short Route KO
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to succeed at catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus short routes less than 10 yards from the LoS

playerAbilities.label: Lurker
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability can make spectacular interceptions while lurking in zones, and are more likely to attempt and succeed at diving swats/catches.

playerAbilities.label: Secure Protector
playerAbilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move.

playerAbilities.label: Run Protector
playerAbilities.description: Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using most quick run block shed moves.

playerAbilities.label: Post Up
playerAbilities.description: Blockers with this ability have a slightly increased chance to win any double team block they are engaged in.

playerAbilities.label: Threat Detector
playerAbilities.description: Players with this ability will highlight any user defenders.

playerAbilities.label: Edge Threat
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

playerAbilities.label: Quick Jump
playerAbilities.description: Players with this ability have a slightly reduced stamina cost and slightly longer perfect window for jumping snaps.

playerAbilities.label: El Toro
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability have a slightly improved chance to receive dominant bull rush wins when their stamina is full. This consumes a large amount of additional stamina.

playerAbilities.label: Interior Threat
playerAbilities.description: Defenders with this ability are slightly more likely to use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the interior of the defense, and have more favorable disengage angles.

playerAbilities.label: Short Out Elite
playerAbilities.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

playerAbilities.label: Mid Out Elite
playerAbilities.description: Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes less than 10-20 yards from the LoS, outside the numbers

playerAbilities.label: Quick Jump
playerAbilities.description: Players with this ability have a slightly reduced stamina cost and slightly longer perfect window for jumping snaps.

playerAbilities.label: Quick Jump
playerAbilities.description: Players with this ability have a slightly reduced stamina cost and slightly longer perfect window for jumping snaps.
